name: web-fashion-store-menu-listing-mobile-scatter-board
title: Scattered board of fashion mega-menu, listing, footer and mobile screens
whatItIs: A pale grey board with several white UI fragments at staggered positions: a mega menu with category columns and photo tiles, a hoodie product listing with filters, a black footer with a cropped giant wordmark, and two mobile screens (home and product detail).
whatItMeans: Orderly and neutral; scattering fragments shows the breadth of a design system without one long page.
techniques: Scatter screens across a neutral board rather than aligning them.
Use a mega menu with a featured photo row.
Label photo tiles with small white text on the image.
Close with a black footer and giant cropped brand name.

vocabulary.definition: A large dropdown that shows many categories and images.
A presentation with screens placed at varied positions.
A vertical list of collapsible filters.
A row of promoted tiles in a menu.
